_doc: Five real production H3 jobs replayed with the same frames, seed and settings. A = the prompt the platform agent actually sent (verbatim). AL = MiniMax's alignment line + A. B = A rewritten in the official guide format (docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md). Durations: 5 s = 124 f = 5.17 s, 6 s = 158 f = 6.58 s, 7 s = 175 f = 7.29 s.

turntable.A: Static tripod shot, the camera does not move at all: no zoom, no push-in, no pan. The car stays the same size in frame the whole time. A black Honda Stepwgn Spada e:HEV MPV stands on a round display turntable in a dark, glossy luxury showroom. The turntable rotates at one slow, steady speed from the first frame to the last, and the car turns with it as one rigid object: front-left three-quarter view at the start, straight-on front view exactly at the middle, and front-right three-quarter view at the end. The turntable platform and its glowing rim stay fully visible under the wheels throughout. Wheels planted, not spinning. The car's boxy shape, LED headlight bar, H emblem and SPADA plate stay exact and steady. Cool highlights glide along the gloss black paint, and the floor reflection turns with the car. Sound: quiet showroom room tone and a soft turntable motor hum.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a static shot frames a black Honda Stepwgn Spada e:HEV MPV in the position and framing established by Picture 1, standing on a round display turntable with a softly glowing rim in a dark, glossy showroom lined with tall vertical light panels, the car's nose angled toward the left of the frame. The camera holds a static shot for the whole shot while the turntable rotates at one slow, steady speed and the car turns with it as one rigid object, its wheels planted on the platform. Cool highlights glide along the gloss black paint and the reflection in the polished floor turns with the car. Midway through, the car faces the camera straight on, its LED headlight bar, H emblem and front plate reading "SPADA" square to the lens. The turn continues at the same speed, the remaining difference narrowing until the car settles into the angle, spacing and composition established by Picture 2 at the end of the shot, its nose angled toward the right of the frame.

overall_soundscape: Quiet showroom room tone with the soft, steady hum of the turntable motor beneath the platform.

approach.align: How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the 5.17-second mark of the target video.
approach.A: Turquoise Green Proton e.MAS 7 SUV in a soft grey photo studio with diagonal light rays. The car starts small in the far background, drives straight towards the camera at a steady pace and rolls to a stop exactly at the final frame: head-on, centred, its real normal size. The car keeps its exact real proportions, shape, colour, wheels and badges the whole time; it is a rigid real car seen through a locked-off camera, so it grows only by perspective as it approaches. Camera: static, no zoom. Sound: a quiet electric motor hum and soft tyre roll, settling to silence.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic product film, a static shot looks straight down a soft grey photo studio where diagonal rays of light fall across a pale seamless backdrop. Far in the background, small in the centre of the frame, the turquoise-green Proton e.MAS 7 electric SUV shown in <Picture 1> faces the camera with its slim LED headlights on. The camera holds a static shot as the car drives straight toward the lens at a steady pace, growing in the frame only through perspective, its body, wheels, crest and front plate reading "e.MAS7" keeping their exact shape and colour. Over the last second the car slows, rolls to a gentle stop and settles into the head-on, centred position, size, lighting and composition established by <Picture 1>.

overall_soundscape: A quiet electric motor hum and the soft roll of tyres on the studio floor grow closer, then settle into silence as the car stops.

exit.align: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; Picture 2 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 5.17-second mark of the target video.
exit.A: A single locked-off tripod view. First and last pictures are the EXACT SAME blue dusk skyline road camera. The turquoise Proton e.MAS 7 shown initially accelerates horizontally to screen right and fully leaves the right edge during the first second. The car moves; the camera remains perfectly fixed. From second 1 through second 5, hold the exact empty road skyline shown in the last reference. Background towers, river, clouds, rich blue dusk exposure, guardrail and horizon remain fixed in their original pixel positions for the whole take. Vehicle remains a rigid correct e.MAS7 with authentic front plate and badge while visible, wheels rotate. Absolutely stationary camera, same blue dusk throughout. Audio: single tyre passing rush then quiet city ambience. No speech, no music, no words.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a static shot at road level holds the framing established by Picture 1: a wet riverside highway at blue dusk, a skyline of lit towers across the water under a deep blue sky of rippled clouds, and the turquoise Proton e.MAS 7 electric SUV in the lower left of the frame, its front plate reading "e.MAS7". The camera holds a static shot throughout. The car accelerates hard to the right, wheels turning, and within the first second it crosses the frame and leaves past the right edge. For the rest of the shot the empty road, guardrail, towers, river and clouds stay exactly where they are while the reflections on the wet asphalt shimmer faintly, matching the empty scene established by Picture 2 at the end of the shot.

overall_soundscape: A single rush of tyres on wet asphalt sweeps quickly to the right, then fades into quiet city ambience with distant traffic.

The car's shape, paint, wheels, crest and e.MAS7 plate stay identical throughout. Even soft studio light, no shadow. Silent.

toy.align: For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
toy.A: One continuous locked-off shot at ground level, no cuts. The red SUV sitting on the gravel close to the lens is a small toy model. The young man in the olive overshirt keeps running toward the camera, slows, then crouches down right behind and beside the red toy car and leans over it, resting one hand on its roof: next to his head and shoulders it is revealed to be a tiny toy. He looks into the camera and grins. There is only one red car. The crane and stacked wrecks stay in the background. Overcast daylight, no text, no logos.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, the static ground-level shot of <Picture 1>: a scrapyard of dark wet gravel under an overcast sky, a small red toy model SUV sitting on the gravel close to the lens in the lower half of the frame so it looks full size, and a young man with short dark hair, in an open olive overshirt over a black T-shirt and khaki trousers, running toward the camera between stacks of crushed cars, a green crane holding a steel grab behind him. The camera holds a static shot throughout. The man keeps running toward the camera and slows as he reaches the red car, then crouches right behind and beside it and leans over it, resting one hand on its roof. Next to his head and shoulders the red car is revealed to be a tiny toy, smaller than his torso. He looks into the lens and grins. There is only one red car.

overall_soundscape: Running footsteps crunch on wet gravel and grow louder, then slow to a scuff as he crouches. A faint creak from the crane and distant scrapyard clanks sit under a light outdoor breeze.
